title: Crisp tab transition: no hard cut, no blank flash, fade-through panels
changes: Tab switching no longer hard-cuts: the panels (controls and results) are captured with the View Transitions API and cross-moved instead of being re-rendered and faded in from an empty screen
The old panel leaves quickly and the new one arrives right after it, so two texts are never visible on top of each other
Panels slide a short distance (22px out, 36px in) with a gentle settle instead of a large bounce
The colour push is shorter (1.15s) with a softer overshoot, and its edge is feathered so it no longer shows as a sharp vertical line
Browsers without View Transitions, and reduced-motion users, fall back to the previous in-place animation or no animation
